overrides.mechanism: Once the issuer is the printed 'Bed Bath and Beyond Inc.' for all of the issuer's tranches (ABL FILO, Roll Up DIP, Super-Priority DIP), the matcher pairs rows of different tranches. The end side is moved to the row of the same printed tranche (instrument cell) at the end date.
overrides.residual_risk: Super-Priority DIP 2023-06-30 (fair value 50.4M) has no pair to the 2023-09-30 Super-Priority DIP row: an override can move the end of an existing pair but cannot add a pair, so that chain stays broken at this step.
